name: Banh bong lan trung muoi
summary: Bánh bông lan trứng muối is sponge cake with salted egg yolk, cheese, and pork floss. Vietnam Tourism sets the sweet cake against the salt of the yolk and the cheese.
origin: Vung Tau, on Vietnam Tourism’s local-eating article. A street was not printed.
taste: Vietnam Tourism says the cake is sweet and the salted yolk and cheese are salty.
howToEat: Eat a slice as a snack or a sweet.
Vietnam Tourism does not print an hour or a price. Check on arrival.
where: Vung Tau. Vietnam Tourism does not name a street. Check on arrival.
